    17	smooth proper geometrically integral curve `C/k`, following Kleiman, "The
    18	Picard scheme", §2 and §4 (cf. FGA Explained Ch. 9; arXiv:math/0504020).
    19	
    20	The relative Picard functor is
    21	
    22	```
    23	picSharp C := PicSharp.relPresheaf C ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat
    24	```
    25	
    26	the set-valued shadow of the `H_T`-coset carrier
    27	`T ↦ Pic(C ×_k T)/π_T^* Pic(T)` of `Picard/RelPicFunctor.lean` (Kleiman §2
    28	Def. `df:Pfs`; blueprint `def:rel_pic_sharp`). A `RepresentableBy` witness
    29	against it is a natural bijection

    12	This is the single, self-contained **statement file** of the project: it collects every
    13	definition, instance, and theorem needed to *state* the main result, and nothing else. A reviewer
    14	reads this one file, compares it against the original challenge (`references/challenge.lean`, by
    15	Christian Merten) and its base-change extension, and is convinced the project formalizes the right
    16	thing. The genuinely-missing pieces are `sorry`; the base-change scaffolding (`baseChange`, the
    17	stability instances, `idIso`, `compIso`, and `Jacobian.congr` derived from `Jacobian.functor`) is
    18	genuinely proved here. Proofs of the `sorry`s live in the rest of the `AlgebraicJacobian/` tree and
    19	must not weaken or restate any signature below.
    20	
    21	By a **smooth curve** we mean a geometrically irreducible, smooth scheme of relative dimension one
    22	over a field, proper over that field.
    23	
    24	## Main definitions
    25	
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.genus` — genus of a proper, smooth curve.
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian` — the Jacobian of a proper, smooth curve.
    28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.ofCurve` — the Abel–Jacobi map associated to a `k`-rational point.
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.functor` — functoriality of the Jacobian, bundled as a single
    30	  contravariant functor `(Curve k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Grp (Over (Spec k))`.
    31	
    32	## Main theorems
    33	
    34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus` — the Jacobian is smooth of relative
    35	  dimension `g = genus C`.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp` — the universal property: the Jacobian is
    37	  the Albanese variety of `C`.
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.baseChangeIso` — the Jacobian commutes with base change of fields,
    39	  together with the identity/cocycle coherences (`baseChangeIso_id`, `baseChangeIso_comp`) and the
    40	  Abel–Jacobi compatibility `baseChange_ofCurve`.

/-- The self-transition is the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem overlapIso_self [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) : overlapIso ρ i i = Iso.refl _ := by
  simp [overlapIso]

/-- The gluing datum of invariant-ring quotient charts attached to all stable
affine opens of the acted scheme. -/
noncomputable def quotientGlueData [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    Scheme.GlueData where
  J := StableAffineOpen ρ
  U i := quotientChart ρ i
  V p := quotientOverlap ρ p.1 p.2
  f i j := quotientOverlapι ρ i j
  f_id i := quotientOverlapι_self_isIso ρ i
  f_open i j := quotientOverlapι_isOpenImmersion ρ i j
  t i j := (overlapIso ρ i j).hom
  t_id i := by rw [overlapIso_self]; rfl
  t' i j k := overlapTransition' ρ i j k
  t_fac i j k := overlapTransition'_fac ρ i j k
  cocycle i j k := overlapTransition'_cocycle ρ i j k

/-- In a glued quotient chart, the inverse image of another chart is exactly
the quotient overlap used in the gluing datum. -/
theorem quotientGlueData_chart_preimage_opensRange
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    (quotientGlueData ρ).ι j ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange =
      (quotientOverlapι ρ j i).opensRange := by
  have hp := IsPullback.of_isLimit
    ((quotientGlueData ρ).vPullbackConeIsLimit j i)
  change (quotientGlueData ρ).ι j ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange =
    ((quotientGlueData ρ).f j i).opensRange
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst]
  have hfst := hp.isoPullback_hom_fst
  change hp.isoPullback.hom ≫
      pullback.fst ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι j) ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i) =
    (quotientGlueData ρ).f j i at hfst
  have hrange :
      (hp.isoPullback.hom ≫
        pullback.fst ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι j) ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i)).opensRange =
      (pullback.fst ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι j)
        ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i)).opensRange := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    simp
  rw [← hrange]
  congr 1

/-- The scheme obtained by gluing all stable affine invariant-ring quotient
charts. -/
noncomputable def gluedQuotient [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    Scheme := (quotientGlueData ρ).glued

/-- The quotient projection on a stable affine chart, followed by its inclusion
into the glued quotient. -/
noncomputable def quotientChartProjection [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) : i.U.toScheme ⟶ gluedQuotient ρ :=
  SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine ≫
    (quotientGlueData ρ).ι i

/-- A local quotient projection pulls a glued quotient chart back to the
corresponding source-chart intersection. -/
theorem quotientChartProjection_preimage_opensRange
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    quotientChartProjection ρ j ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange =
      j.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ i.U := by
  unfold quotientChartProjection
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  calc
    _ = SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap
          ρ j.stable j.affine ⁻¹ᵁ
        (quotientOverlapι ρ j i).opensRange :=
      congrArg
        (fun U ↦ SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap
          ρ j.stable j.affine ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (quotientGlueData_chart_preimage_opensRange ρ i j)
    _ = _ := by
      letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction j.stable
      letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f j.U
      letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f j.U
      letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f j.U
      letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections j.stable
      unfold quotientOverlapι quotientOverlap quotientChart
      rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
      rw [SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap_preimage_quotientOpen
        ρ j.stable j.affine inf_le_left (inf_stable ρ j i)]
      simp only [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
      simp

/-- The quotient projection of a stable affine chart lies over `Spec K`. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_quotientChartMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine ≫
        quotientChartMap ρ i =
      (i.U.ι ≫ f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
  let w := SemilinearGalAction.galoisQuotientWitness_quotientOpenOfStableSubopen
    ρ i.stable i.affine le_rfl i.stable
  have hw := GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection.quotientMap_comp_base w
  have hfac := SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMapRestrict_fac
    ρ i.stable i.affine le_rfl i.stable
  calc
    SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine ≫
          quotientChartMap ρ i =
        (X.homOfLE le_rfl ≫
          SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine) ≫
            quotientChartMap ρ i := by rw [Scheme.homOfLE_rfl, Category.id_comp]
    _ = (SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMapRestrict
          ρ i.stable i.affine le_rfl i.stable ≫
        (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable i.U).ι) ≫
          quotientChartMap ρ i :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ quotientChartMap ρ i) hfac.symm
    _ = SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMapRestrict
          ρ i.stable i.affine le_rfl i.stable ≫
        ((SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable i.U).ι ≫
          quotientChartMap ρ i) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      congrArg
        (fun z ↦ ((X.isoOfEq (inf_comm i.U j.U)).hom ≫ z) ≫
          (quotientGlueData ρ).ι j)
        (overlapQuotientMap_fac ρ j i)
    _ = (X.homOfLE inf_le_right ≫
          SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ j.stable j.affine) ≫
          (quotientGlueData ρ).ι j := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hswap]
    _ = X.homOfLE inf_le_right ≫
          (SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ j.stable j.affine ≫
            (quotientGlueData ρ).ι j) := Category.assoc _ _ _

/-- The stable-affine quotient projections satisfy the pullback compatibility
required by `Scheme.OpenCover.glueMorphisms`. -/
theorem quotientChartProjection_compatible
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    pullback.fst i.U.ι j.U.ι ≫ quotientChartProjection ρ i =
      pullback.snd i.U.ι j.U.ι ≫ quotientChartProjection ρ j := by
  rw [← cancel_epi (isPullback_opens_inf i.U j.U).isoPullback.hom]
  simpa only [IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_fst_assoc,
    IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_snd_assoc] using
      quotientChartProjection_inf ρ i j

/-- The quotient projection from the acted scheme to the quotient obtained by
gluing its stable affine quotient charts. -/
noncomputable def gluedQuotientProjection
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ] :
    X ⟶ gluedQuotient ρ :=
  (sourceOpenCover ρ).glueMorphisms (quotientChartProjection ρ)
    (quotientChartProjection_compatible ρ)

/-- Restricting the global quotient projection to a stable affine chart recovers
the pinned local quotient projection. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ]
    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    i.U.ι ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ = quotientChartProjection ρ i := by
  exact (sourceOpenCover ρ).ι_glueMorphisms _ _ i

/-- The global projection to the glued quotient is Galois-invariant. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem act_hom_gluedQuotientProjection
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ]
    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    (ρ.act gamma).hom ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ =
      gluedQuotientProjection ρ := by
  apply (sourceOpenCover ρ).hom_ext
  intro i
  change StableAffineOpen ρ at i
  change (i.U.ι ≫ (ρ.act gamma).hom) ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ =
    i.U.ι ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ
  rw [← SemilinearGalAction.actRes_ι ρ i.stable gamma]
  rw [Category.assoc, sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection]
  change ((ρ.restrict i.stable).act gamma).hom ≫
    quotientChartProjection ρ i = quotientChartProjection ρ i
  exact restrict_act_hom_quotientChartProjection ρ i gamma

/-- The global quotient projection pulls a glued quotient chart back to the
stable affine source chart from which it was built. -/
theorem gluedQuotientProjection_preimage_opensRange
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ]
    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    gluedQuotientProjection ρ ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange = i.U := by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := (sourceOpenCover ρ).exists_eq x
  change gluedQuotientProjection ρ (j.U.ι y) ∈
      ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange ↔ j.U.ι y ∈ i.U
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection]
  change y ∈ quotientChartProjection ρ j ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange ↔ y ∈ j.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ i.U
  rw [quotientChartProjection_preimage_opensRange]

/-- The structure maps of the invariant-ring quotient charts glue to a map to
`Spec K`. -/
noncomputable def gluedQuotientMap [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    gluedQuotient ρ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := by
  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
  · exact quotientChartMap ρ
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩
    change quotientOverlapι ρ i j ≫ quotientChartMap ρ i =
      ((overlapIso ρ i j).hom ≫ quotientOverlapι ρ j i) ≫
        quotientChartMap ρ j
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      (overlapIso_hom_base ρ i j).symm

/-- Each quotient chart inclusion lies over the chart's invariant-ring
structure map. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem quotientGlueData_ι_gluedQuotientMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    (quotientGlueData ρ).ι i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ = quotientChartMap ρ i :=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

/-- A local quotient projection followed by the glued structure map is its
source chart's structure map over `Spec K`. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem quotientChartProjection_gluedQuotientMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    quotientChartProjection ρ i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ =
      (i.U.ι ≫ f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
  have hchart := quotientGlueData_ι_gluedQuotientMap ρ i
  calc
    quotientChartProjection ρ i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ =
        SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine ≫
          ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ) := by
      unfold quotientChartProjection
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap ρ i.stable i.affine ≫
          quotientChartMap ρ i :=
      congrArg
        (fun z ↦ SemilinearGalAction.stableAffineQuotientMap
          ρ i.stable i.affine ≫ z)
        hchart
    _ = (i.U.ι ≫ f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) :=
      stableAffineQuotientMap_quotientChartMap ρ i

/-- The global quotient projection lies over `Spec K`. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem gluedQuotientProjection_gluedQuotientMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ] :
    gluedQuotientProjection ρ ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ =
      f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
  apply (sourceOpenCover ρ).hom_ext
  intro i
  change i.U.ι ≫ (gluedQuotientProjection ρ ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ) =
    i.U.ι ≫ (f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
  rw [← Category.assoc, sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection]

(hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom) (hqc : QuasiCompact J.hom) :
    (JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy C J rep hlft hqc).rep = rep :=
  rfl

/-- The universal property of a packaged datum is the packaged representation. -/
@[simp]
lemma JacobianData.homEquiv_ofRepresentableBy (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom) (hqc : QuasiCompact J.hom)
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : T ⟶ J) :
    (JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy C J rep hlft hqc).homEquiv g = rep.homEquiv g :=
  rfl

/-! ## The chart family and its glued object -/

section Charts

variable {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
  (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)

/-- **The structure morphism of the `i`-th chart** over the base field: the Σ-component of the
element of `pic0SigmaFunctor C` classified by `f i`.  A chart of the degree-zero Picard sheaf
is by construction a scheme *together with* a map to `Spec k`, namely the base over which the
line bundle it classifies lives; this is that map. -/
noncomputable def chartHom (i : ι) : X i ⟶ Spec (.of k) := (yonedaEquiv (f i)).1

variable (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
variable [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)]

/-- **The structure morphism of the glued object of a chart family**: mathlib's 01JJ engine
glues the charts into a scheme representing the Σ-extension sheaf, and the Σ-component of the
universal element of that representation is the map of that scheme to `Spec k`. -/
noncomputable abbrev gluedHom :
    (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
  ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
    (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1

/-- **The glued object of a chart family**, as a scheme over the base field.  This is the
object represented by `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`. -/
noncomputable abbrev gluedOfCharts : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (gluedHom C f hf)

/-- The universal element of the glued representation restricts along the `i`-th glue map to
the element classified by `f i`. -/
lemma representableBy_homEquiv_toGlued (i : ι) :
    (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
      (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.toGlued hf i) = yonedaEquiv (f i) :=
  Scheme.LocalRepresentability.yonedaGluedToSheaf_app_toGlued hf

/-- **The charts are charts over the base field**: the `i`-th glue map into the glued object,
followed by the structure morphism of the glued object, is the structure morphism of the `i`-th
chart.  Both sides are Σ-components of the same restriction of the universal element. -/
lemma toGlued_comp_gluedHom (i : ι) :
    Scheme.LocalRepresentability.toGlued hf i ≫ gluedHom C f hf = chartHom C f i := by
  have h := congrArg Sigma.fst
    ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv_eq
      (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.toGlued hf i))
  rw [representableBy_homEquiv_toGlued] at h
  exact h.symm

/-! ## The two finiteness certificates from the charts -/

/-- **Locally of finite type descends from the charts**: the property is local on the source
and the glue maps of the glue data cover the glued object, so if each chart is locally of finite
type over the base field then so is the glued object. -/
theorem locallyOfFiniteType_gluedHom (hlft : ∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (chartHom C f i)) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (gluedHom C f hf) := by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover
    (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType) (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).openCover fun i => ?_
  have h := hlft i
  rwa [← toGlued_comp_gluedHom C f hf i] at h

/-- **Quasi-compactness descends from a finite family of quasi-compact charts**: the base
`Spec k` is affine, so quasi-compactness of the structure morphism is compactness of the space
of the glued object, and that space is the union of the finitely many compact chart images. -/
theorem quasiCompact_gluedHom [Finite ι] (hcpt : ∀ i, CompactSpace (X i)) :
    QuasiCompact (gluedHom C f hf) := by
  haveI : Finite (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).openCover.I₀ := ‹Finite ι›
  haveI : ∀ i, CompactSpace ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).openCover.X i) := hcpt
  haveI : CompactSpace (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued :=
    (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).openCover.compactSpace
  exact HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine.mpr ‹_›

/-! ## The producer -/

/-- **The first producer of the Jacobian datum**: a Zariski chart family of relatively
representable open immersions into the Σ-extension sheaf of the degree-zero Picard functor,
jointly locally surjective, indexed by a finite type, with quasi-compact charts that are locally
of finite type over the base field, produces the pinned representability datum of the curve.

The representing object is the glued scheme of the family, placed over `Spec k` by the
Σ-component of the universal element; the two certificates are `locallyOfFiniteType_gluedHom`

     9	/-!
    10	# A finite affine atlas for the separably closed Picard representer
    11	
    12	The exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer is quasi-compact, quasi-separated, and
    13	locally of finite presentation over the ground field.  This file combines those facts
    14	into a finite affine atlas whose overlap spaces are quasi-compact and whose chart rings

    16	data needed to spread the representer out from a separable closure.
    17	-/

    29	/-! ## A project-local finite-cover supplement -/
    30	
    31	/-- A quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme has a finite affine open cover with
    32	quasi-compact pairwise intersections. -/
    33	theorem Scheme.exists_finite_affineCover_inter_isQuasiCompact (X : Scheme.{u})
    34	    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    35	    ∃ s : Set X.affineOpens, s.Finite ∧ (⨆ i ∈ s, (i : X.Opens)) = ⊤ ∧
    36	      ∀ U ∈ s, ∀ V ∈ s, IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ (V : Set X)) := by
    37	  obtain ⟨s, hs, he⟩ :=
    38	    (isCompact_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_affineOpens (U := (⊤ : X.Opens))).mp
    39	      (by simpa using isCompact_univ (X := X))
    40	  refine ⟨s, hs, he.symm, ?_⟩
    41	  intro U _ V _
    42	  exact quasiSeparatedSpace_iff_forall_affineOpens.mp ‹_› U V
    43	
    44	/-- A finite affine presentation of the intersection of two affine opens.  Besides
    45	covering the intersection exactly, it records finite presentation of both restriction
    46	maps from the chart rings to every overlap-piece ring. -/
    47	structure Scheme.FiniteAffineOverlapPresentation (X : Scheme.{u})
    48	    (U V : X.affineOpens) where
    49	  pieces : Set X.affineOpens
    50	  finite_pieces : pieces.Finite
    51	  iSup_opens : (⨆ W ∈ pieces, (W : X.Opens)) = U.1 ⊓ V.1
    52	  piece_le_left : ∀ W ∈ pieces, W.1 ≤ U.1
    53	  piece_le_right : ∀ W ∈ pieces, W.1 ≤ V.1
    54	  leftRestriction_finitePresentation : ∀ W (hW : W ∈ pieces),
    55	    (X.homOfLE (piece_le_left W hW)).appTop.hom.FinitePresentation
    56	  rightRestriction_finitePresentation : ∀ W (hW : W ∈ pieces),
    57	    (X.homOfLE (piece_le_right W hW)).appTop.hom.FinitePresentation
    58	
    59	/-- A compact intersection of two affine opens admits a finite affine overlap
    60	presentation.  The two restriction maps are finitely presented because the inclusions
    61	of the affine overlap pieces into the affine charts are open immersions. -/
    62	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteAffineOverlapPresentation (X : Scheme.{u})
    63	    (U V : X.affineOpens) (h : IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ (V : Set X))) :
    64	    X.FiniteAffineOverlapPresentation U V := by
    65	  apply Classical.choice
    66	  obtain ⟨s, hs, he⟩ :=
    67	    (isCompact_iff_finite_and_eq_biUnion_affineOpens (U := U.1 ⊓ V.1)).mp
    68	      (by simpa using h)
    69	  have hle (W : X.affineOpens) (hW : W ∈ s) : W.1 ≤ U.1 ⊓ V.1 := by
    70	    rw [he]
    71	    exact le_iSup_of_le W (le_iSup_of_le hW le_rfl)
    72	  refine ⟨
    73	    { pieces := s
    74	      finite_pieces := hs
    75	      iSup_opens := he.symm
    76	      piece_le_left := fun W hW => (hle W hW).trans inf_le_left
    77	      piece_le_right := fun W hW => (hle W hW).trans inf_le_right
    78	      leftRestriction_finitePresentation := ?_
    79	      rightRestriction_finitePresentation := ?_ }⟩
    80	  · intro W hW
    81	    exact (X.homOfLE ((hle W hW).trans inf_le_left)).finitePresentation_appTop
    82	  · intro W hW
    83	    exact (X.homOfLE ((hle W hW).trans inf_le_right)).finitePresentation_appTop

    85	/-! ## The finite atlas on the exact `Pic^0` representer -/
    86	
    87	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    88	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    89	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    90	
    91	/-- A finite affine atlas on the exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer, including
    92	the two finiteness properties needed for chart-ring spreading: quasi-compact overlaps
    93	and finite presentation of every selected chart ring over the ground field. -/
    94	structure Pic0FiniteStageAtlas where
    95	  charts : Set (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.affineOpens
    96	  finite_charts : charts.Finite
    97	  iSup_opens :
    98	    (⨆ U ∈ charts,
    99	      (U : (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.Opens)) = ⊤
   100	  inter_isCompact : ∀ U ∈ charts, ∀ V ∈ charts,
   101	    IsCompact
   102	      ((U : Set (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left) ∩
   103	        (V : Set (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left))
   104	  chartRing_finitePresentation : ∀ U ∈ charts,
   105	    ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom.appLE
   106	      (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) U.1 le_top).hom.FinitePresentation
   107	  overlapPresentation : ∀ U ∈ charts, ∀ V ∈ charts,
   108	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.FiniteAffineOverlapPresentation U V
   109	
   110	/-- The finite affine atlas obtained from quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, and
   111	local finite presentation of the exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer. -/
   112	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAtlas : Pic0FiniteStageAtlas C := by
   113	  apply Classical.choice
   114	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   115	  letI : QuasiCompact J.hom := quasiCompact_pic0SepClosedRepresenter C
   116	  letI : CompactSpace J.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace J.hom
   117	  letI : QuasiSeparatedSpace J.left := quasiSeparatedSpace_pic0SepClosedRepresenter C
   118	  letI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation J.hom :=
   119	    locallyOfFinitePresentation_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy C
   120	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcover, hinter⟩ :=
   121	    Scheme.exists_finite_affineCover_inter_isQuasiCompact J.left
   122	  refine ⟨
   123	    { charts := s
   124	      finite_charts := hs
   125	      iSup_opens := hcover
   126	      inter_isCompact := hinter
   127	      chartRing_finitePresentation := ?_
   128	      overlapPresentation := fun U hU V hV =>
   129	        J.left.finiteAffineOverlapPresentation U V (hinter U hU V hV) }⟩
   130	  intro U _
   131	  exact J.hom.finitePresentation_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) U.2 le_top
   132	
   133	/-! ## Simultaneous finite-stage chart-ring models -/
   134	
   135	/-- The section ring of one chart in the chosen finite `Pic^0` atlas, equipped below with
   136	the algebra structure induced by the structure morphism of the exact representer. -/
   137	def Pic0FiniteStageChartRing
   138	    (U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }) : Type u :=
   139	  Γ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left, U.1.1)
   140	
   141	instance (U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }) :
   142	    CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) := by
   143	  dsimp [Pic0FiniteStageChartRing]
   144	  infer_instance
   145	
   146	noncomputable instance (U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }) :
   147	    Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) := by
   148	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   149	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
   150	  exact (J.left.overAlgebraMap k U.1.1).toAlgebra
   151	
   152	/-- Every ring in the chosen finite `Pic^0` atlas is finitely presented for its canonical
   153	algebra structure over the separably closed ground field. -/
   154	theorem finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageChartRing
   155	    (U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }) :
   156	    Algebra.FinitePresentation k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) := by
   157	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   158	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
   159	  change (J.left.overAlgebraMap k U.1.1).FinitePresentation
   160	  rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
   161	  apply RingHom.FinitePresentation.comp
   162	  · exact (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).chartRing_finitePresentation U.1 U.2
   163	  · exact RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_bijective
   164	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv)

   166	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
   167	-- Elaborating the dependent quotient inside the tensor product requires a larger typeclass budget.
   168	/-- All chart rings in the finite atlas of the exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer
   169	are simultaneously defined over one finite subextension.  This is the object layer of
   170	spreading out the atlas; restriction maps and their cocycle equations remain separate data. -/
   171	theorem exists_finSubext_pic0FiniteStageAtlas_chartRing_models
   172	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] :
   173	    ∃ L : DatG0.FinSubext F k,
   174	      ∀ U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts },
   175	        ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) L.1,
   176	          Nonempty
   177	            (k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 n m relation ≃ₐ[k]
   178	              Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) := by
   179	  letI : Finite { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts } :=
   180	    (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).finite_charts.to_subtype
   181	  letI (U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }) :
   182	      Algebra.FinitePresentation k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) :=
   183	    finitePresentation_pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U
   184	  exact DatG0.exists_finSubext_finitePresentation_algebra_model_finite
   185	    (fun U : { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts } =>
   186	      Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)

    18	The second step gives a reusable transport equivalence for tensor pushouts, including its

    47	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    48	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)

    64	theorem pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv_naturality
    65	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    66	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    67	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    68	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    69	    (e : forall j,
    70	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    71	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    72	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    73	    (mapM : forall q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
    74	      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    75	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
    76	        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    77	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    78	    (hmapM : forall q,
    79	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    80	          (AlgHom.id L.1
    81	            (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    82	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    83	              (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    84	              (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
    85	          ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
    86	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
    87	          L.1).comp
    88	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    89	            (AlgHom.id L.1
    90	              (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    91	                (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
    92	                (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
    93	                (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))))))

    95	    (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M

   106	    (F := L.1) (L := M.1) (K := k)

   108	    (phiK := pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q)

   116	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange L.1 M.1 k k
   117	      (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   118	        (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   119	        (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   120	        (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))

   126	            (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   127	            (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   128	            (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)))) x) at hx

   132	        (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   133	          (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   134	          (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   135	          (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))

   142	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))

   155	/-! ## Transporting tensor pushouts -/
   156	
   157	/-- Tensor-product pushouts are invariant under compatible equivalences of their base
   158	and two factors.  The result is an equivalence over the common ground ring. -/
   159	noncomputable def tensorPushoutAlgEquivCongr
   160	    {R A1 A2 B1 B2 D1 D2 : Type u}
   161	    [CommRing R] [CommRing A1] [CommRing A2]
   162	    [CommRing B1] [CommRing B2] [CommRing D1] [CommRing D2]
   163	    [Algebra R A1] [Algebra R A2]
   164	    [Algebra R B1] [Algebra R B2] [Algebra R D1] [Algebra R D2]
   165	    (f1 : A1 →ₐ[R] B1) (g1 : A1 →ₐ[R] D1)
   166	    (f2 : A2 →ₐ[R] B2) (g2 : A2 →ₐ[R] D2)
   167	    (eA : A1 ≃ₐ[R] A2) (eB : B1 ≃ₐ[R] B2) (eD : D1 ≃ₐ[R] D2)
   168	    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f1 = f2.comp eA.toAlgHom)
   169	    (hg : eD.toAlgHom.comp g1 = g2.comp eA.toAlgHom) :
   170	    letI : Algebra A1 B1 := f1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   171	    letI : Algebra A1 D1 := g1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   172	    letI : Algebra A2 B2 := f2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   173	    letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   174	    letI : IsScalarTower R A1 B1 :=
   175	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f1.commutes x).symm)
   176	    letI : IsScalarTower R A2 B2 :=
   177	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f2.commutes x).symm)
   178	    B1 ⊗[A1] D1 ≃ₐ[R] B2 ⊗[A2] D2 := by
   179	  letI : Algebra A1 B1 := f1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   180	  letI : Algebra A1 D1 := g1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   181	  letI : Algebra A2 B2 := f2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   182	  letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   183	  letI : IsScalarTower R A1 B1 :=
   184	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f1.commutes x).symm)
   185	  letI : IsScalarTower R A2 B2 :=
   186	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f2.commutes x).symm)
   187	  let P1 := B1 ⊗[A1] D1
   188	  let P2 := B2 ⊗[A2] D2
   189	  let jB : B1 →+* P2 :=
   190	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp eB.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
   191	  let jD : D1 →+* P2 :=
   192	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp eD.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
   193	  have ht : IsPushout
   194	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)
   195	      (CommRingCat.ofHom jB) (CommRingCat.ofHom jD) := by
   196	    apply (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A2 B2 D2).of_iso'
   197	      eA.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso eB.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso
   198	      eD.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (Iso.refl (CommRingCat.of P2))
   199	    · ext x
   200	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf.symm x
   201	    · ext x
   202	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hg.symm x
   203	    · rfl
   204	    · rfl
   205	  have hs : IsPushout
   206	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)
   207	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
   208	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)))
   209	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
   210	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)).toRingHom) :=
   211	    CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A1 B1 D1
   212	  let ie : CommRingCat.of P1 ≅ CommRingCat.of P2 :=
   213	    hs.isoIsPushout (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   214	  have left_formula (b : B1) :
   215	      ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = eB b ⊗ₜ[A2] (1 : D2) := by
   216	    have hleft := hs.inl_isoIsPushout_hom
   217	      (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   218	    have hx := congrArg
   219	      (fun q : CommRingCat.of B1 ⟶ CommRingCat.of P2 => q.hom b) hleft
   220	    change ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = jB b at hx
   221	    exact hx
   222	  let re : P1 ≃+* P2 := ie.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   223	  refine AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := re) fun x => ?_
   224	  change ie.hom.hom (((algebraMap R B1) x) ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) =
   225	    ((algebraMap R B2) x) ⊗ₜ[A2] (1 : D2)
   226	  rw [left_formula, eB.commutes]
   227

   234	    [Algebra R A1] [Algebra R A2]

   237	    (f2 : A2 →ₐ[R] B2) (g2 : A2 →ₐ[R] D2)
   238	    (eA : A1 ≃ₐ[R] A2) (eB : B1 ≃ₐ[R] B2) (eD : D1 ≃ₐ[R] D2)
   239	    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f1 = f2.comp eA.toAlgHom)
   240	    (hg : eD.toAlgHom.comp g1 = g2.comp eA.toAlgHom) :
   241	    letI : Algebra A1 B1 := f1.toRingHom.toAlgebra

   243	    letI : Algebra A2 B2 := f2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   244	    letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra

   258	  letI : Algebra A1 D1 := g1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   259	  letI : Algebra A2 B2 := f2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   260	  letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   261	  letI : IsScalarTower R A1 B1 :=

   263	  letI : IsScalarTower R A2 B2 :=
   264	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f2.commutes x).symm)

   266	  let P2 := B2 ⊗[A2] D2
   267	  let jB : B1 →+* P2 :=
   268	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp eB.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
   269	  let jD : D1 →+* P2 :=
   270	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp eD.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
   271	  have ht : IsPushout
   272	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)
   273	      (CommRingCat.ofHom jB) (CommRingCat.ofHom jD) := by
   274	    apply (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A2 B2 D2).of_iso'
   275	      eA.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso eB.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso
   276	      eD.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (Iso.refl (CommRingCat.of P2))
   277	    · ext x
   278	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf.symm x
   279	    · ext x
   280	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hg.symm x
   281	    · rfl
   282	    · rfl
   283	  have hs : IsPushout
   284	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)
   285	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
   286	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)))
   287	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
   288	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)).toRingHom) :=
   289	    CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A1 B1 D1

   291	    hs.isoIsPushout (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   292	  constructor
   293	  · intro b
   294	    change ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = eB b ⊗ₜ[A2] (1 : D2)
   295	    have hleft := hs.inl_isoIsPushout_hom
   296	      (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   297	    have hx := congrArg
   298	      (fun q : CommRingCat.of B1 ⟶ CommRingCat.of P2 => q.hom b) hleft
   299	    change ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = jB b at hx

   305	    have hx := congrArg

   398	    let p : overSpec k K ⟶ Tbar := Over.testPoint (T := Tbar) t
   399	    let muK : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K) := (pic0TypeFunctor C).map p.op mu
   400	    obtain ⟨a, x, hx⟩ :=
   401	      exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization (C := C) hopen muK
   402	    let q : (overSpec k K).left := Classical.choice inferInstance
   403	    have hq : p.left.base q = t := by
   404	      dsimp only [p]
   405	      exact Over.testPoint_base (T := Tbar) t q
   406	    refine ⟨(overSpec k K).left, q, p.left, a, x, ?_, ?_⟩
   407	    · exact hq
   408	    · exact hx.trans (Over.sigmaExtension_map_left_mk p mu).symm

   410	/-- Over a separably closed field, openness of the rank-one Picard locus gives a scheme
   411	representing `Pic^0`.  This conditional form keeps the geometric gluing argument reusable. -/
   412	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   413	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   414	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   415	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   416	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   417	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   418	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   419	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   420	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   421	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C f
   422	    (fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a)⟩
   423	
   424	/-- Over a separably closed field, `Pic^0` is represented by the scheme obtained by gluing the
   425	translated canonical rank-one Abel charts. -/
   426	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   427	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J :=
   428	  pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   429	    (C := C) (picRankOneOpen_isOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C))

    38	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    39	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    40	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    41	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    42	  intro y
    43	  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    44	    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
    45	  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
    46	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    47	    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
    48	  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
    49	  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
    50	  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
    51	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
    52	  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
    53	  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
    54	  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
    55	  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
    56	  rw [hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hqz
    57	  exact hqz

    59	/-- The admissible Abel chart, viewed as a scheme morphism to the exact separably closed

    30	/-! ## The two slice presentations of a deck transformation -/
    31	
    32	/-- The deck transformation of a base-changed test, packaged as a morphism in
    33	the slice over `Spec L`. -/
    34	noncomputable def pic0GalTwistMor
    35	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    36	    (pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T) ⟶
    37	      baseTest (k' := L) T :=
    38	  Over.homMk (pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma)
    39	    (pullbackGalMap_snd K L T.hom gamma)
    40	
    41	@[simp]
    42	theorem pic0GalTwistMor_left
    43	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    44	    (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).left = pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma :=
    45	  rfl
    46	
    47	/-- Base change of a morphism of `K`-tests, regarded as a morphism of their
    48	base changes over `Spec L`. -/
    49	noncomputable def pic0GaloisBaseChangeMor
    50	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T) :
    51	    baseTest (k' := L) T' ⟶ baseTest (k' := L) T :=
    52	  Over.homMk (pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w)
    53	    (pullbackBaseChange_snd K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w)
    54	
    55	theorem pic0GaloisBaseTestMap_eq_restrict_map
    56	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T) :
    57	    pic0GaloisBaseTestMap (L := L) a =
    58	      (pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
    59	        (pic0GaloisBaseChangeMor (L := L) a) :=
    60	  rfl
    61	
    62	/-- The inverse comparison from a twisted `L`-test to the original test is the
    63	identity on underlying schemes. -/
    64	theorem pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_inv_app_left
    65	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (D : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))) :
    66	    ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app D).left = 𝟙 D.left := by
    67	  have h := congrArg Over.Hom.left
    68	    ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom_inv_id_app D)
    69	  rw [Over.comp_left, pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_hom_app_left] at h
    70	  have hfixed : @Eq (D.left ⟶ D.left)
    71	      (𝟙 D.left ≫ ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app D).left)
    72	      (𝟙 D.left) := h
    73	  rw [Category.id_comp] at hfixed
    74	  exact hfixed
    75	
    76	/-- The `K`-slice deck transformation indexed by `gamma⁻¹` is the restriction
    77	of the `L`-slice deck transformation indexed by `gamma`, after the canonical
    78	identity-underlying comparison of their sources. -/
    79	theorem twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor
    80	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    81	    twistTest T gamma⁻¹ =
    82	      (pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app (baseTest (k' := L) T) ≫
    83	        (pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
    84	          (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma) := by
    85	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    86	  rw [Over.comp_left, pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_inv_app_left,
    87	    Over.map_map_left, pic0GalTwistMor_left]
    88	  have hfixed : @Eq
    89	      (Limits.pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra K L) ⟶
    90	        Limits.pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra K L))
    91	      (𝟙 _ ≫ pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma)
    92	      (pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma) :=
    93	    Category.id_comp _
    94	  exact hfixed.symm

    96	/-! ## Transporting deck invariance through theta -/

    98	section ThetaAction
    99	
   100	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   101	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   102	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   103	
   104	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   105	-- Normalizing both theta components and the restriction-twist inverse is expensive.
   106	/-- The theta comparison carries invariance under the inverse-indexed deck
   107	transformation to the canonical Galois-action equation. -/
   108	theorem pic0_theta_invariant_iff_action
   109	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   110	    (y : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).obj
   111	      (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   112	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
   113	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (twistTest T gamma⁻¹).op
   114	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   115	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   116	        (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   117	          (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y ↔
   118	      (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   119	          (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y =
   120	        (pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   121	          (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y := by
   122	  constructor
   123	  · intro h
   124	    rw [twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor,
   125	      op_comp, Functor.map_comp] at h
   126	    have he : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   127	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   128	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   129	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   130	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   131	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   132	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   133	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   134	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   135	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := by
   136	      calc
   137	        _ = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   138	            ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   139	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   140	            ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   141	              ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app
   142	                (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   143	              ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   144	                ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   145	                  (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   146	                ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   147	                  (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y))) := by
   148	            symm
   149	            rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
   150	              Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
   151	            simpa using Functor.map_id_apply (pic0TypeFunctor C)
   152	              (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma ⋙
   153	                pic0GaloisRestrictTest).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T))) _
   154	        _ = _ := congrArg ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   155	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   156	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op) h
   157	    apply (Iso.toEquiv ((pic0ThetaType K L C).app
   158	      (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   159	        (baseTest (k' := L) T))))).injective
   160	    change (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   161	        (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   162	          ((pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   163	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y) =
   164	      (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   165	        (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   166	          ((pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   167	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y)
   168	    rw [pic0GaloisAction_inv_app_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   169	    rw [pic0GaloisActionRestricted_inv_app]
   170	    rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply]
   171	    exact he
   172	  · intro h
   173	    have htheta := congrArg ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   174	      (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   175	        (baseTest (k' := L) T)))) h
   176	    have he : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   177	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   178	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   179	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   180	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   181	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   182	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   183	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   184	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   185	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := by
   186	      calc
   187	        _ = (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   188	            (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   189	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   190	            ((pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   191	              (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y) :=
   192	          (NatTrans.naturality_apply (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom
   193	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y).symm
   194	        _ = (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   195	            (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   196	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   197	            ((pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   198	              (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := htheta
   199	        _ = _ := by
   200	          rw [pic0GaloisAction_inv_app_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   201	          rw [pic0GaloisActionRestricted_inv_app]
   202	          rfl
   203	    rw [twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor,
   204	      op_comp, Functor.map_comp]
   205	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   206	        ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app

/-!
# Gluing Schemes

Given a family of gluing data of schemes, we may glue them together.
Also see the section about "locally directed" gluing,
which is a special case where the conditions are easier to check.

## Main definitions

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData`: A structure containing the family of gluing data.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.glued`: The glued scheme.
    This is defined as the multicoequalizer of `∐ V i j ⇉ ∐ U i`, so that the general colimit API
    can be used.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι`: The immersion `ι i : U i ⟶ glued` for each `i : J`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isoCarrier`: The isomorphism between the underlying space
  of the glued scheme and the gluing of the underlying topological spaces.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.gluedCover`: The glue data associated with an open cover.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.fromGlued`: The canonical morphism
  `𝒰.gluedCover.glued ⟶ X`. This has an `is_iso` instance.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.glueMorphisms`: We may glue a family of compatible
  morphisms defined on an open cover of a scheme.

## Main results

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_isOpenImmersion`: The map `ι i : U i ⟶ glued`
  is an open immersion for each `i : J`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_jointly_surjective` : The underlying maps of
  `ι i : U i ⟶ glued` are jointly surjective.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit` : `V i j` is the pullback
  (intersection) of `U i` and `U j` over the glued space.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_eq_iff` : `ι i x = ι j y` if and only if they coincide
  when restricted to `V i i`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isOpen_iff` : A subset of the glued scheme is open iff
  all its preimages in `U i` are open.

## Implementation details

All the hard work is done in `Mathlib/Geometry/RingedSpace/PresheafedSpace/Gluing.lean` where we
glue presheafed spaces, sheafed spaces, and locally ringed spaces.

-/

  exact (sourceOpenCover ρ).ι_glueMorphisms _ _ i

/-- The global projection to the glued quotient is Galois-invariant. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem act_hom_gluedQuotientProjection
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ]
    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    (ρ.act gamma).hom ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ =
      gluedQuotientProjection ρ := by
  apply (sourceOpenCover ρ).hom_ext
  intro i
  change StableAffineOpen ρ at i
  change (i.U.ι ≫ (ρ.act gamma).hom) ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ =
    i.U.ι ≫ gluedQuotientProjection ρ
  rw [← SemilinearGalAction.actRes_ι ρ i.stable gamma]
  rw [Category.assoc, sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection]
  change ((ρ.restrict i.stable).act gamma).hom ≫
    quotientChartProjection ρ i = quotientChartProjection ρ i
  exact restrict_act_hom_quotientChartProjection ρ i gamma

/-- The global quotient projection pulls a glued quotient chart back to the
stable affine source chart from which it was built. -/
theorem gluedQuotientProjection_preimage_opensRange
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ]
    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    gluedQuotientProjection ρ ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange = i.U := by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := (sourceOpenCover ρ).exists_eq x
  change gluedQuotientProjection ρ (j.U.ι y) ∈
      ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange ↔ j.U.ι y ∈ i.U
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, sourceOpenCover_f_gluedQuotientProjection]
  change y ∈ quotientChartProjection ρ j ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((quotientGlueData ρ).ι i).opensRange ↔ y ∈ j.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ i.U
  rw [quotientChartProjection_preimage_opensRange]

/-- The structure maps of the invariant-ring quotient charts glue to a map to
`Spec K`. -/
noncomputable def gluedQuotientMap [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    gluedQuotient ρ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := by
  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
  · exact quotientChartMap ρ
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩
    change quotientOverlapι ρ i j ≫ quotientChartMap ρ i =
      ((overlapIso ρ i j).hom ≫ quotientOverlapι ρ j i) ≫
        quotientChartMap ρ j
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      (overlapIso_hom_base ρ i j).symm

/-- Each quotient chart inclusion lies over the chart's invariant-ring
structure map. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem quotientGlueData_ι_gluedQuotientMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    (quotientGlueData ρ).ι i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ = quotientChartMap ρ i :=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

/-- A local quotient projection followed by the glued structure map is its
source chart's structure map over `Spec K`. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem quotientChartProjection_gluedQuotientMap
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    quotientChartProjection ρ i ≫ gluedQuotientMap ρ =
      (i.U.ι ≫ f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
  have hchart := quotientGlueData_ι_gluedQuotientMap ρ i
  calc

    12	under the explicitly supplied orbit-in-an-affine-open instance.  It is not the
